title: Two Important Texas Hold'em Words: Fold and Bluff
summaryJa: テキサスホールデムの基本用語「フォールド」（降りる）と「ブラフ」（ハッタリ）の意味と使い方について説明します。初心者がこれらの言葉を理解することで、ゲームの戦略がより明確になります。
segments: Texas Hold'em poker has many special words. Two of the most important words are "fold" and "bluff.
" These words help you understand the game. Let's learn what they mean.
First, let's talk about "fold. " To fold means to quit the current hand.
When you fold, you do not play anymore. You give up your cards and the money you put in.
You do this when you think your cards are not good enough. For example: A player has two weak cards.
The other players make big bets. The player decides to fold.
Now this player is out of the hand. The other players keep playing.
Next, let's learn about "bluff. " A bluff is when you bet or raise money, but your cards are not really good.
You want other players to think you have better cards than you do. You want them to fold.
For example: A player has weak cards. But this player bets a lot of money.
The other players think, "Maybe this player has strong cards. " They get scared.
They fold their cards. Now the first player wins the pot, even though his cards were not the best.
Both fold and bluff are important skills in Texas Hold'em. Good players use these words every day.
When you fold, you save money. When you bluff, you can win money with weak cards.
Learning these two words helps you play better poker.
